text_en: Soldier, you're here. You had me worried.
Sirfiel has informed me that the situation was critical.
What's more, that soldier Melian has returned and is in a very bad way.
As much as it bothers me, I could do nothing more than wait for you to return safe and sound and, somehow, you always do.
You mean to say he revealed the location of the Guardian to you?
Do you think the information is trustworthy this time?
I see...
Say no more! If there's anything I've learnt from your reports, it's that you're an intuitive soldier.
Our departure from this city nears. The search for the Guardian begins Tomorrow.
Try to use what's left of the day to rest. Tomorrow we march for <color=LOC>Hel Swamp</color>.
That's everything for now. You may leave, soldier.
Well done.
Hey, soldier!
Can't sleep either?
I can't sleep a wink, but for a pretty different reason to yours.
A little birdy told me that you've found out where the Guardian is and you're planning to go and find him so that you can go back to your world.
I hope you can. After everything you've done, you deserve it.
Oh, no, no... I don't claim to know where he is. One day, I'll look for him too.
I know that my time's passed, but I feel like that I have to do it to see what's out there for me.
It makes me sad to think you're all leaving tomorrow. It's been fun to have guests like you guys, and I've learnt a tonne of things besides magic, for a change...
That reminds me... I have a reward for you, to thank you for that sword you got me.
You know? I think it's the first time I've seen you rest since you arrived.
Anyway, I think it's time I try to get some sleep. Don't stay up all night, you'll want to be in good shape for tomorrow.
I'll leave you with your thoughts. Good luck, whatever happens.
Beigon...
That's the Guardian's name.
Jivan told me it once.
Sleep well.
